l4_steps.name: Maintain cost centre hierarchy in SAP CO
l4_steps.input: Approved organisational structure and departmental headcount plan
l4_steps.output: Cost centre master data with hierarchy nodes aligned to P&L structure
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of cost centres mapped to a valid profit centre before period open
l4_steps.pain_point: Organisational restructures (e.g. new MRO subsidiary, alliance JV) require manual CO hierarchy redesign; no automated sync from SAP SuccessFactors org chart

l4_steps.name: Load approved budget baseline into SAP CO
l4_steps.input: Board-approved annual budget locked in SAP BPC
l4_steps.output: Cost centre plan versions activated in SAP CO for current fiscal year
l4_steps.kpi: Budget upload completed ≤3 business days after board approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual mapping required between SAP BPC planning dimensions and SAP CO cost element groups; version mismatch causes reforecast figures to overwrite locked baseline

l4_steps.name: Configure activity types and internal activity rates
l4_steps.input: Planned cost centre volumes (flight hours, maintenance man-hours, FTE counts)
l4_steps.output: Validated activity type rates for internal cost transfers (e.g. $/flight-hour, $/MHR)
l4_steps.kpi: Activity rate variance vs prior year ≤5%; all rates signed off by Finance Director
l4_steps.pain_point: Flight-hour activity rates must be reconciled against Jeppesen crew pairing outputs; late crew schedule changes invalidate planned rate calculations after period open

l4_steps.name: Capture direct cost postings via SAP FI/MM
l4_steps.input: Supplier invoices, purchase orders, and expense reports from SAP Concur
l4_steps.output: Verified FI document postings assigned to correct cost centres and cost elements
l4_steps.kpi: Invoice processing cycle time ≤2 days; <0.5% posting error rate per period
l4_steps.pain_point: Aircraft fuel invoices from multi-supplier contracts require manual cost element split between line maintenance and flight operations cost centres; no automated split rule in standard SAP MM

l4_steps.name: Run periodic assessment cycles for indirect costs
l4_steps.input: Closed FI period with all direct postings; allocation cycle configuration
l4_steps.output: Indirect costs distributed from sender cost centres (IT, HR, Finance) to receiver cost centres
l4_steps.kpi: Assessment cycle runtime ≤4 hours; 100% of sender cost centre balances zeroed after cycle
l4_steps.pain_point: IT infrastructure costs shared across 20+ airline business units require quarterly review of allocation keys; stale keys from pre-cloud migration era overallocate to legacy data centre cost centres

l4_steps.name: Settle maintenance work orders to cost objects
l4_steps.input: Completed maintenance work orders with labour, parts, and subcontract costs
l4_steps.output: Settled maintenance costs transferred from AMOS work orders to SAP CO cost centres or internal orders
l4_steps.kpi: Work order settlement rate ≥98% within 5 business days of task completion
l4_steps.pain_point: AMOS-to-SAP CO integration relies on batch interface; late settlement of heavy maintenance C-checks causes significant under-absorption variances in MRO cost centres at period-end

l4_steps.name: Validate allocation cycles balanced to zero
l4_steps.input: Completed assessment and settlement cycle results
l4_steps.output: Period-close sign-off confirmation; unallocated balance report
l4_steps.kpi: Unallocated balance <$1,000 (rounding tolerance) per sender cost centre after cycle
l4_steps.pain_point: Incorrect sender/receiver split factors from ad-hoc project cost centres prevent full balance clearance; requires manual journal workaround which bypasses standard CO cycle logic

l4_steps.name: Extract flight-level unit costs from SAP CO-PA
l4_steps.input: Settled cost centre and order actuals; flight schedule from Amadeus SkyWORKS
l4_steps.output: Per-flight cost breakdown by cost element (fuel, crew, maintenance, fees, overhead)
l4_steps.kpi: CASM (Cost per Available Seat Mile) calculated for 100% of operated flights within 48 hours of period close
l4_steps.pain_point: CO-PA account-based model requires manual derivation rules for mapping operational cost drivers (tail number, route) to profitability segments; missing derivation rules create blank segment records that distort CASM calculations

l4_steps.name: Join revenue and capacity data via AWS Redshift
l4_steps.input: Passenger revenue from Amadeus Altéa PSS; ancillary revenue from booking engine; ASM/RPM from Amadeus SkyWORKS
l4_steps.output: Integrated flight-level dataset combining cost, revenue, and capacity metrics
l4_steps.kpi: Data pipeline latency ≤6 hours after period close; revenue reconciliation variance vs FI ledger <0.1%
l4_steps.pain_point: Amadeus Altéa proration logic for interline and codeshare itineraries produces estimated revenue splits; actuals are only available after IATA BSP settlement (30-day lag), creating provisional revenue figures in monthly management accounts

l4_steps.name: Calculate CASM, RASM, and contribution margin
l4_steps.input: Integrated flight-level dataset from AWS Redshift
l4_steps.output: Route-level and fleet-type profitability scorecard (CASM, RASM, load factor, contribution margin $/seat)
l4_steps.kpi: Network contribution margin ≥18% of total revenue; CASM ex-fuel ≤8.5¢
l4_steps.pain_point: Allocation of fleet ownership costs (depreciation, lessor rentals) to routes requires arbitrary ASM-based split; aircraft utilisation swings caused by irregular operations distort per-route cost benchmarks

l4_steps.name: Flag underperforming routes for network review
l4_steps.input: Route profitability scorecard; minimum profitability threshold (CFO-approved)
l4_steps.output: Route watch-list submitted to Network Planning for schedule review in Amadeus SkySYM
l4_steps.kpi: Routes with contribution margin <5% for 3 consecutive months escalated within 5 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: Seasonal routes and new route ramp-up periods require judgement-based exclusion from watch-list; absence of a formal ramp-up tolerance policy leads to premature escalation of viable long-term routes

l4_steps.name: Run budget vs actuals comparison in SAP BPC
l4_steps.input: Locked budget baseline; period actuals loaded from SAP S/4HANA FI/CO
l4_steps.output: Variance report by cost centre, cost element, and P&L line
l4_steps.kpi: Variance report published ≤4 business days after period close
l4_steps.pain_point: SAP BPC data model refresh from S/4HANA requires nightly batch job; ad-hoc reforecasts during the period create multiple BPC plan versions that are difficult to reconcile with the locked baseline

l4_steps.name: Classify and quantify material variances by type
l4_steps.input: Variance report; cost centre manager commentary submitted via email or SharePoint
l4_steps.output: Variance classification register (price variance, volume variance, mix variance, one-off items)
l4_steps.kpi: ≥90% of variances >$50K classified and explained within 5 business days of period close
l4_steps.pain_point: Fuel price variances require decomposition into volume, price, and hedge settlement components; hedge P&L is recorded in a separate SAP FI treasury module with no direct CO linkage, requiring manual reconciliation

l4_steps.name: Determine if variance requires CFO escalation
l4_steps.input: Classified variance register; materiality thresholds approved by CFO
l4_steps.output: Escalation decision: CFO notified within 24 hours if threshold breached
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of variances exceeding $500K or 10% of cost centre budget escalated within 24 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Materiality thresholds are static (set at year-start) and do not adjust for mid-year reforecast changes; cost centres that received budget cuts become hypersensitive to small nominal variances

l4_steps.name: Conduct root-cause analysis with cost centre managers
l4_steps.input: Escalated variance items; cost centre transaction drill-down from SAP CO
l4_steps.output: Root-cause analysis memo; corrective action plan with owner and due date
l4_steps.kpi: Root-cause memo issued within 3 business days of escalation trigger
l4_steps.pain_point: Operational cost centre managers (e.g. Maintenance Base, Ground Ops) have limited SAP CO access and rely on Finance to extract drill-down data; information asymmetry delays variance explanation by 2–3 days

l4_steps.name: Compile monthly management accounts pack
l4_steps.input: Variance analysis, route profitability scorecard, corrective action plans
l4_steps.output: Monthly management accounts pack (P&L, cost bridge, KPI dashboard, CFO narrative)
l4_steps.kpi: Management pack distributed to CFO and ExCo ≤6 business days after period close
l4_steps.pain_point: Management pack relies on manual Excel consolidation of Tableau outputs, SAP BPC variance reports, and treasury hedge commentary; multi-source assembly creates version control risk and delays when any single source is late

l4_steps.name: Issue cost reduction directives to business units
l4_steps.input: Approved cost control decisions from CFO review of management pack
l4_steps.output: Revised cost centre spending authorities; updated BPC reforecast with reduction targets
l4_steps.kpi: Cost reduction directives issued within 2 business days of ExCo approval
l4_steps.pain_point: Spending authority changes require SAP CO cost centre budget updates AND updates to SAP Ariba procurement approval hierarchies; the two systems are not integrated, so purchasing limits frequently lag behind finance decisions

l4_steps.name: Trigger rolling reforecast cycle in SAP BPC
l4_steps.input: Cost reduction directives; updated fuel price and capacity assumptions
l4_steps.output: Revised full-year forecast published in SAP BPC; new CASM and EBITDAR outlook circulated
l4_steps.kpi: Rolling reforecast completed and published ≤10 business days after period close
l4_steps.pain_point: Mid-year capacity changes (aircraft AOG events, network schedule revisions from Amadeus SkyWORKS) invalidate the ASM base used for CASM forecasting; reforecasts become stale within days if not linked to live schedule data
